intent.description: Use when a substantive task or agreed stage is ready to close, a related new question follows completed work, or repeated investigation or scope drift obscures the original outcome. Also use when the user asks to step back, 收口, or 回看目标. Not a checkpoint for every reply or an extra approval gate for already authorized work.
intent.job_to_be_done: Distinguish completed work from related new work without interrupting authorized progress.
inputs: Current request, agreed scope, available completion evidence
outputs: A brief closure or scope-calibration statement when useful

should_trigger: 阶段完成，可以收口了吗？
已完成，又有一个关联新问题。
should_not_trigger: 继续执行已批准计划的第二步。
near_neighbor: 请对整个项目做深入复盘。
提交前测试失败，请修复。

degradation.unavailable: No automatic reminder is guaranteed when the skill is not discovered or loaded.

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
